llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed LYGO TV pointer and website embed package; its local scripts are read-only printers, while the browser embed clearly discloses its network activity.

dimensions.detail: The embed is active browser code that fetches chatagent.ca catalog data, optional hls.js from jsdelivr with SRI, platform embeds, and stream hosts; this is proportionate to a web TV player and is repeatedly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Install examples are pinned to clawhub@0.23.3 and lygo-tv@1.3.1; local commands invoke Python scripts that print text and URLs, and self_check confirmed no script network imports or subprocess use.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The agent instructions are specific to LYGO TV, free TV/IPTV/public M3U, and embed requests, with explicit exclusions for piracy, generic media widgets, proxies, pay-TV decryption, and invented playlists.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No system persistence, background workers, credential/session store use, local file writes, or privilege escalation were found; the embed only stores a visitor-side sound preference in localStorage.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to point users to LYGO TV and provide an embeddable player; inspected artifacts match that purpose and do not show unrelated local data access, publishing, proxying, decryption, or account mutation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that the local skill is mostly a pointer and snippet printer, but any site using the embed will load active third-party browser content and a mutable channel catalog. Review embed/README.md and use the vendored/pinned option if your site needs tighter control; donation links are optional and not required for the player.
llm.findings:
[LP1] expected: For embed/lygo-tv-ninja.js, browser network use is expected for a TV embed and is explicitly separated from the local scripts in SKILL.md, claw.json, embed/README.md, and SECURITY.md.
[LP1] expected: For scripts/lygo_tv.py, the skill frontmatter allows Bash invocation of this Python script, and the script itself does not spawn shells or subprocesses; it prints static text, URLs, JSON, and embed snippets.
[RP1] unexpected: The cited install command is pinned in the inspected artifact as npx clawhub@0.23.3 install deepseekoracle/lygo-tv@1.3.1, so the artifact evidence does not support a floating-version install concern.
[SDI-1] expected: Donation and referral URLs are present, but they are disclosed as optional support and do not execute transactions, request credentials, or gate player functionality.
[SDI-2] expected: The donate command only prints PayPal, Patreon, and Rumble join URLs; it is explicit, user-invoked, and separated from the main embed/player output.
